accounting.rationale: The paragraph combines function execution, function-result characteristics, and value determination; Clause 15 owns the operational plans.
Function reference execution during expression evaluation produces a data entity. 15.5.3 owns invocation, actual evaluation, argument association, and function-body execution plans.
Type, type parameters, and rank of a function result are determined by its interface. 15.3.3 and 15.5.3 own result characteristics.
The function result value is determined by executing the function; 15.5.3 owns concrete result-availability plans.
